name: Classical Civilization
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits outside Classical Studies
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Classical Studies department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: First Year Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Quantitative Reasoning Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement
requirements.hint: one 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: From approved HU-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved NS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved SS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Additional Distribution: complete 3 areas
requirements.hint: Pick any 3 of the area buckets below and hit 3 cr in each. ID credit can count toward 1, 2, or all 3 areas, so the extra ID buckets can stand in for additional areas.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Humanities.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Natural Sciences.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Social Sciences.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Mathematical & Symbolic Analysis
requirements.hint: From approved MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Creative Expression
requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Interdisciplinary
requirements.hint: From approved ID-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Second Area)
requirements.hint: A second 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a second area.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Third Area)
requirements.hint: A third 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a third area.

requirements.label: Prerequisite: 4 Credits of Introductory Coursework
requirements.hint: 4 credits from: CLCIV 101, CLCIV 202, HISTORY 200, HISTORY 201, GTBOOKS 191, CLARCH/ARCHAM 221, or CLARCH/ARCHAM 222.

requirements.label: 1 200-Level CLCIV Course
requirements.hint: One CLCIV course at the 200 level, minimum 3 credits.

requirements.label: CLCIV 480: Studying Antiquity (Capstone Seminar)
requirements.hint: Capstone Seminar, CLCIV 480 Section 1. Minimum 2 credits.

requirements.label: CLCIV 480: Capstone Research Seminar
requirements.hint: CLCIV 480 Section 2, Topic 10. This is a second enrollment in CLCIV 480, separate from the Capstone Seminar; plan CLCIV 480 twice, once per section.

requirements.label: Cluster Requirement: 3 Courses from One Cluster
requirements.hint: Complete 3 courses from a single cluster: (A) Language, Literature, and Reception; (B) History and Archaeology; or (C) Religion and Philosophy. Cluster course lists below are from the Classical Studies cluster list on the LSA bulletin's Classical Civilization major page (effective Fall 2024). The department notes the lists are not exhaustive, so confirm cluster choices with the major advisor.

requirements.label: Cluster A: Language, Literature, and Reception (3 courses)
requirements.hint: Per the department's cluster list on the LSA bulletin's Classical Civilization major page (effective Fall 2024): CLCIV 328, 371, 385, 464, 473; GREEKMOD 325, 340; Ancient Greek at the 300 and 400 level; and Latin at the 200, 300, and 400 level. The list is not exhaustive; confirm with the major advisor.

requirements.label: Cluster B: History and Archaeology (3 courses)
requirements.hint: Per the department's cluster list on the LSA bulletin's Classical Civilization major page (effective Fall 2024): CLCIV 302, 365, 372, 375, 376, 382, 392 (crosslisted as HISTORY 292), 468; plus 300 and 400 level CLARCH/ARCHAM courses. Greek and Latin language courses with a history focus can also count with prior approval from the major advisor. The list is not exhaustive; confirm with the major advisor.

requirements.label: Cluster C: Religion and Philosophy (3 courses)
requirements.hint: Per the department's cluster list on the LSA bulletin's Classical Civilization major page (effective Fall 2024): CLCIV 293, 347, 381, 388 (crosslisted as PHIL 388), 389, 466, 475, 476. Greek and Latin language courses with a religion or philosophy focus can also count with prior approval from the major advisor. The list is not exhaustive; confirm with the major advisor.

requirements.label: 3 300-Level CLCIV Courses
requirements.hint: Minimum 3 credits each course. Can include courses used in the cluster requirement.

requirements.label: 2 400-Level CLCIV Courses
requirements.hint: Minimum 3 credits each course. Can include courses used in the cluster requirement.

requirements.label: 1 Additional 200-Level or Above CLCIV Course
requirements.hint: Minimum 3 credits. Can include courses used in the cluster requirement.

requirements.label: Major Total: 24 Credits
requirements.hint: Minimum 24 credits, including all courses used toward the major requirements, even those from other departments. Does not include any prerequisites. The planner counts 200-level or above CLCIV courses; approved courses from other departments also count.
